article.title: Power of Central Government to give directions.
article.content: The Central Government may give directions to State Governments as to the carrying into execution of the provisions of this Act.
article.html:
30Power of Central Government to give directions.

Section 30 · Chapter VII · page 9 of the Act

The Central Government may give directions to State Governments as to the carrying into execution of the provisions of this Act.
